entity_data.description: Streetlights are outdoor lighting fixtures installed along streets and public areas to provide illumination for safety and visibility. They include various types such as wood pole, concrete pole, and private development streetlights on city right-of-way. entity_data.name: new proposed building
entity_data.description: This project involves replacing an existing building with a new pre-K building located at 1109 Andalusia Avenue, Coral Gables, Florida. The project includes the removal of an old detached garage, adherence to setback requirements, and construction of multipurpose and classroom spaces with fixed inoperable windows. The new building will be set back from the neighboring property to the east and will feature a space that opens to the backyard for activities.
